name: blender_sollumz
instruction: Use ONLY when the user explicitly asks for Sollumz, FiveM, GTA, MLO, CodeWalker, YDR/YDD/YBN/YTYP/YMAP, drawables, archetypes, collisions, rooms, or portals. Do NOT use this workflow for generic Blender scene creation, reference images, container cafes, shops, buildings, or normal 3D modeling. Sollumz Workflow for FiveM MLOs & Props. CORE PIPELINE: 1. Extract game exterior/collision files via CodeWalker as XMLs. 2. Import XMLs into Blender via Sollumz. 3. Model interior Shell (floors, walls, ceilings). 4. Set Face Orientation (Normals) to facing inward. 5. Use Sollumz panel to define MLO properties, Rooms, and Portals (crucial for rendering). 6. Create Collision Meshes (.ybn). 7. Export back to CodeWalker XMLs via Sollumz. EXPORT FORMATS: .ydr (drawables/models), .ydd (dictionaries), .ybn (collisions), .ytyp (MLO archetypes). TIPS: If textures go missing, use 'Find Missing Textures' in Sollumz. Portals must bridge room boundaries perfectly to avoid visibility glitches.
